# `duplicate-import`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports the same module path imported more than once in one file.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Duplicate aliases add dependency noise and can make readers wonder whether two
module instances differ.

## When it fires

It applies to simple private top-level imports where path equality and
comment-safe removal are clear.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");
const also_std = @import("std");
```
